turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> M{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    M -->|Received document| AS1[Run floor nouns against document]
    AS1 --> AS2[Compress to residue in STE]
    AS2 --> AS3[Report residue, evaporation, operative sentence, and finding]
    AS3 --> AS4[This is a finding, not a draft]
    AS4 --> Z[Stop]

    M -->|Draft prompt| B{Mode stated or inferable?}
    B -->|No| B1[Ask for mode]
    B1 --> W[Wait for answer]
    W --> B
    B -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| C{Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path}
    C -->|Gaps| D[Ask up to three questions or state assumptions]
    D --> W
    C -->|Floor passes| E[Apply compression loop]

    E --> E1{Did a cut remove specification?}
    E1 -->|Yes| E2[Name decorative or destructive cut and revert]
    E2 --> E
    E1 -->|No| E3{Two consecutive Cut: nothing. lines?}
    E3 -->|No| E4{Does the floor still pass?}
    E4 -->|No| E5[Return the last passing version]
    E5 --> F[Output the optimized prompt]
    E4 -->|Yes| E
    E3 -->|Yes| F

    F --> G[Ask: Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?]
    G -->|Keep negotiating| E
    G -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| H{Execution tools available?}
    H -->|No| H1[Keep the gate closed and report no run]
    H -->|Yes| I[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    I --> J{Result}
    J -->|Success| K[Done]
    J -->|Floor item fails| L[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    L --> E
```
